gameName: Back to the Future: The Card Game
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently watched a Back to the Future movie goes first.
officialTieBreak: If tied, the player who has watched the movies the greatest number of times starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
